description: Synthetic falsification fixture coverage for fixture-backed observables. These fixtures validate registry structure only and do not claim runtime telemetry.

fixtures.condition: A positive fixture is marked valid while violating a named invariant.
non_claims: Synthetic fixture only.
Does not validate a production schema lane.
Does not claim runtime deployment status.

fixtures.condition: A negative fixture passes or fails for a reason other than the intended invariant.
non_claims: Synthetic fixture only.
Does not assert a live validator result.
Does not claim production schema completeness.

fixtures.condition: A soft-lane output is promoted without evidence, policy, audit, and promotion decision.
non_claims: Synthetic fixture only.
Does not represent a real detector finding.
Does not claim an actual soft-lane promotion occurred.

fixtures.condition: A promotion decision omits the evidence level or maturity class required for reliance.
non_claims: Synthetic fixture only.
Does not assert a real promotion decision.
Does not claim certificate schema completeness.

fixtures.condition: Multiple promoted conclusions depend on one evidence source without independence disclosure or concentration warning.
non_claims: Synthetic fixture only.
Does not claim live dependency telemetry.
Does not assert production capability-tier invocation data.

fixtures.condition: Cancellation path hides a contradiction instead of producing a contradiction record or reversal trigger.
non_claims: Synthetic fixture only.
Does not claim runtime cancellation telemetry exists.
Does not assert production policy behavior.

fixtures.condition: Human actor maps to reputation or governance consequence without consent evidence.
non_claims: Synthetic fixture only.
Does not describe a real person.
Does not create a reputation record.

fixtures.condition: Candidate proof pack maps to promoted Stele certificate without promotion decision.
non_claims: Synthetic fixture only.
Does not assert a real proof pack exists.
Does not claim certificate bridge implementation.

fixtures.condition: Undecided certificate maps to Atlas admission instead of deny or review-required.
non_claims: Synthetic fixture only.
Does not claim Atlas bridge exists.
Does not authorize admission behavior.

fixtures.condition: Pattern C or prohibited pattern maps to admit rather than deny.
non_claims: Synthetic fixture only.
Does not claim Pattern C bridge implementation.
Does not assert production admission behavior.
